subject: Dedicated reservation options for NovusCare pilot and phased activation
messages:
From: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@novuscare.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot sizing and reserve options

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency numbers looked promising. We're starting to map out the pilot (internal ML inference for triage scoring) and need to understand what reservation options you can offer for a 3–6 month pilot that could convert to full production. High level constraints:

- Expected peak concurrency: ~120 concurrent requests with median sequence lengths ~512 tokens.
- Monthly token volume estimate: ~400M tokens.
- Hard requirement: data isolation and SOC2 controls (we'll push security questionnaire separately).

Could you sketch cluster size / minimum GPU options, a conservative ramp schedule, and any warm-up/activation credits you would include? Also send any proposal PDF we can run past procurement.

Sophie
Sophie Lang
CTO, NovusCare

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@novuscare.ai>, NovusCare Procurement <procurement@novuscare.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot sizing and reserve options

Sophie — thanks for the clear constraints, and great talking yesterday. Attached is a short proposal (novuscare-dedicated-options-v1.pdf) plus an activation schedule workbook that lays out the ramp scenarios. Executive summary here:

Option A — Conservative pilot (recommended for validation)
- Cluster: 6 x A100 (or equivalent) dedicated GPUs
- Min reservation: 4 GPUs guaranteed (soft floor)
- Burst capacity: up to 2 additional GPUs for short-window peaks (auto-burst)
- Expected latency: median 120ms per request (512 tokens)
- Warm-up credit: 50k tokens for model KV-cache priming
- Timeline: activate within 2 weeks of contract signature, steady-state by week 3

Option B — Production-onfasttrack
- Cluster: 12 x A100 dedicated
- Min reservation: 8 GPUs guaranteed
- Burst: 4 GPUs burstable
- Warm-up credit: 200k tokens and one-week prewarm window
- Timeline: phased activation over 4 weeks with canary traffic

Fallbacks and guarantees:
- Automatic fallback to compatible quantized variant if warm start fails for latency-sensitive routes.
- SLA target: 99.5% availability per month for reserved lanes; we can discuss higher for Dedicated contracts.

Pricing note: the attachment includes a committed-rate table and estimated per-token unit economics under each option.

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm which option you want to pilot with (A or B) and whether procurement wants a redlineable PDF.
2) We'll schedule an activation-readiness call with Karthik (runtime sizing/ops) and Marcus (onboarding cadence) to finalize the timeline.

I've cc'd Karthik to own the activation plan details. I'll also share our SOC2 checklist in a separate email.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Attachments: novuscare-dedicated-options-v1.pdf, activation-schedule.xlsx
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot sizing and reserve options

Looping in Marcus for onboarding velocity. Quick internal notes for the activation call:

- The customer's concurrency/seq-length profile maps to ~3500 tokens/sec sustained at median traffic; 4 A100s should cover baseline inference with conservative batching but leaves little headroom for spiky bursts. Recommend Option A as a low-risk validation but change the min reservation from 4 -> 5 GPUs to keep a 20% safety buffer.
- Warm-up: suggest we deliver a KV-cache priming script + an initial synthetic traffic generator. That will reduce cold-start variance during week 1.
- Ramp schedule: sign -> 48h infra allocation -> 72h prewarm -> week 1 limited traffic -> week 3 steady-state. If procurement pushes for cost-efficiency, propose a mid-pilot review for right-sizing.
- Activation playbook: include a rollback path to hosted-compatible model variant to protect SLAs.

Marcus — can you confirm we can guarantee 48h allocation for a 6-GPU physical pool in us-west region given typical inventory? If not, we should flag a 7–10 day lead time in the proposal.

Thanks,
Karthik
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@novuscare.ai>, NovusCare Procurement <procurement@novuscare.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 15:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot sizing and reserve options

Sophie / procurement team — following internal sizing we've adjusted the recommended pilot baseline slightly to give you operational headroom without a large up-front commitment. Key updates (also updated in attached PDF):

Agree on a single pilot option to move forward: "Pilot S" (blends A/B features)
- Cluster: 8 x A100-equivalent dedicated GPUs (reserved pool)
- Min reservation: 5 GPUs guaranteed (soft guaranteed floor with 24h scale policy)
- Burst: up to 3 additional GPUs for short windows (auto-burst)
- Warm-up: 150k token priming credit + KV priming script + synthetic traffic harness
- Activation cadence: 48h allocation, 72h prewarm & smoke tests, week 1 limited traffic (10–25% of expected traffic), week 3 steady-state

Commercial path & next steps:
1) Procurement: I'll attach a redline-friendly PDF if you'd like to start the contract loop.
2) Tech kickoff: we'll schedule a 60-minute activation readiness call (Karthik + Marcus + NovusCare infra lead) — suggested times next Wed/Thu.
3) DocuSign: if procurement approves, we'll send the DocuSign link for signature and coordinate the 48h allocation window on receipt of countersigned order.

Links: HubSpot deal NVSC-2027-0422, DocuSign (proposal) included in links above.
Attachments: novuscare-dedicated-options-v1.pdf (updated), activation-schedule.xlsx

Looking forward — happy to jump on a call to walk through the activation workbook.

Best,
Kimberly Park
